system.description:
You deliver a single falling kick, strong enough to bring the environment crumbling down around you. Make a melee Taijutsu attack against a creature within range. On a hit you deal your Unarmed damage + 1d12 and the target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save they gain 1 rank of Slowed until the end of their next turn.

Finisher: you instead deal your [Unarmed damage] + 3d12 and on a failed save the target falls Prone as your force them into the ground shattering it, causing the area within a 10ft cube originating from you to be treated as difficult terrain.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d12.
